approved_requirements.statement: Validate the Universal Loop M2 to M3 SHADOW pipeline against the existing approved GRIMOIRE mobile star-circuit visual and UX contracts without changing product UI or visual canon.
acceptance_criteria: Visual Lock references only existing user-authorized visual/UX contracts.
Existing visual-platform structural contract remains green.
The unmodified Base SHADOW Kernel completes with EXISTING_LOCKED and NO_DRIFT.
No product, planning, visual asset, scene, data, or project.godot path is modified.

protected_meanings: FIVE_POINT_STAR remains the active circuit layout and THREE_BY_THREE is historical only.
TARGET selection remains after circuit preview and outside the circuit.
Explicit commit and multi-solution UX remain required.
HUMAN_NOT_RUN and DEVICE_NOT_RUN boundaries remain explicit and are not upgraded by this pilot.
excluded_scope: No TASK8 product implementation or new visual design is selected by this pilot.
No final art, Figma mutation, image generation, asset replacement, runtime UI edit, or device validation is included.
No human/device/performance validation claim is created.
